name: dhadkan
description: Dhadkan: npm run demo starts the backend and the web app with the NASA IMS bearing replay and the agent

scripts.demo: node -e "const w = process.platform === 'win32'; const r = require('child_process').spawnSync(w ? 'powershell' : 'make', w ? ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', 'dev.ps1', 'demo-ims'] : ['demo-ims'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1)"
